# דוגטאון פנסיון בוטיק — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> A boutique dog training and boarding business focused on positive reinforcement and reward-based methods, working with all breeds except those classified as dangerous by the government registry. The brand targets owners of small and toy breeds like Pomeranian, Corgi, and Shih Tzu, offering hourly training sessions (at the facility or client's home), training boarding packages, and regular boarding — all 7 days a week. The desired branding features warm earthy tones and green hues, evoking a natural, nurturing, and safe environment for beloved small dogs.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About דוגטאון פנסיון בוטיק
A boutique dog training and boarding business focused on positive reinforcement and reward-based methods, working with all breeds except those classified as dangerous by the government registry. The brand targets owners of small and toy breeds like Pomeranian, Corgi, and Shih Tzu, offering hourly training sessions (at the facility or client's home), training boarding packages, and regular boarding — all 7 days a week. The desired branding features warm earthy tones and green hues, evoking a natural, nurturing, and safe environment for beloved small dogs.

## Services/Products
- סשנים שעתיים של אילוף – בפנסיון ובבית הלקוח
- פנסיון אילוף לפי ימים
- פנסיון רגיל לפי ימים
- גישת חיזוקים חיוביים ותגמול

## Target Audience
- בעלי גורים וכלבים קטנים כמו פומרניין, קורגי ושיצו
- בעלי גורים
- בעלי כלבים קטנים
- בעלי כלבים בעיר

## Industry
טיפול ואימון בעלי חיים
